messages:
Ana Rivera: Kicking off a quick sync — CloudScale wants the marketplace listing + joint blog to go live same day as our landing page. Can we confirm launch window?
Mike Chen: for Redwood side, ops prefers UTC window 09:00-11:00 to align with EU/US overlap. Is that ok for CloudScale? @CloudScale - Priya
CloudScale - Priya: 09:00-11:00 UTC works for us. We need the press embargo lifted at 08:30 UTC to distribute assets.
Julie Park: noted. We need design sign-off by EOD tomorrow for the partner hero and 2 screenshots. @Mike can you confirm creative handoff ETA?
Mike Chen: handing off to design by 18:00 PT today. putting the files in: https://drive.redwood.co/marketplace/partners/cloudscale/assets
Tom Reilly: ops checklist for the day (high level):
```
- 07:30 UTC: internal readiness call (15m)
- 08:00 UTC: infra health check + DNS TTL decrease
- 08:30 UTC: embargo lift & press release distribution
- 09:00 UTC: landing page + marketplace listing publish
- 09:10 UTC: smoke test + telemetry validation
- 09:45 UTC: launch retrospection & incident handoff
```
Sree Nandakumar: adding SI onboarding note — Partner SI (EdgeWorks) needs API keys rotated and test tenant provisioned before 08:00 UTC. @Tom can infra confirm provisioning window?
Tom Reilly: infra will provision test tenant by 07:15 UTC. I'll run a provisioning playbook and paste logs in the runbook channel.
Ana Rivera: Who owns the joint blog final content? We had PR draft v2 in hackmd but need final approval and a short partner quote.
Julie Park: I can own the blog wrap. @CloudScale - Priya can you provide a 30-40 word quote by EOD? Also we should lock the meta description and hero CTA copy now: "Try CloudScale on Redwood — Launch in minutes."
CloudScale - Priya: quote incoming by 17:00 PT. CTA copy ok from our side.
Mike Chen: Marketing needs the canonical URLs to wire into the campaign flow. Proposed: landing page /cloudscale and marketplace listing /partners/cloudscale. Any objections?
Ana Rivera: fine. Tom, set redirects and make sure GA/UTM tags are present.
Tom Reilly: will add UTM template and set redirects. Also pre-warm CDN cache with a TTL of 1hr before publish.
Sree Nandakumar: SI runbook ops: include rollback steps if listing fails — fallback to partner page + banner. I'll draft the rollback snippet:
```
1) Repoint /partners/cloudscale to hold page
2) Revert listing via marketplace API: POST /v1/private/listings/{id}/revert
3) Notify partner channel + open incident if >10% errors
```
Mike Chen: quick ask — can someone volunteer to be launch-day oncall (09:00-11:00 UTC)? we need 2 infra, 1 comms, 1 partner PM.
Julie Park: I can take comms 08:30-10:30 UTC.
Tom Reilly: I'll take infra primary 07:30-09:30 UTC, then handoff to @Sree for 09:30-11:30 UTC.
Sree Nandakumar: ok taking infra secondary 09:30-11:30 UTC.
Ana Rivera: @Mike can you add these people to the launch calendar invite and create a brief runbook doc: https://handbook.redwood.co/launches/cloudscale-runbook (please update with contact numbers)
Mike Chen: putting it on the calendar now and will update runbook with phone tree.
LaunchBot: Automated reminder scheduled: "Pre-launch health check" 07:45 UTC on launch day -> #ops-bridge
Ana Rivera: final blockers? Anything we need legal to sign off on embargo language?
Julie Park: legal already cleared the embargo wording yesterday. I'll cc legal on the publish thread.
CloudScale - Priya: partner-side checklist complete except for the quote. We'll be standing by during the 08:30-10:00 UTC window.
Mike Chen: great — new action items list (short):
- Julie: finalize blog + quote placeholder (by EOD)
- Mike: calendar + runbook updates (today)
- Tom: infra pre-provision + CDN pre-warm (launch day morning)
- Sree: rollback snippet into runbook (today)
- Priya: partner quote (by 17:00 PT)
Ana Rivera: thanks team. I'll post a final "launch readiness: go/no-go" at 06:00 UTC day-of. If no objections by then we proceed. :rocket:
